Select: molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary INNER JOIN compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: molecule_dictionary.molregno IN (SELECT molregno FROM compound_records WHERE doc_id = (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1150404')). Sort: molecule_chembl_id ASC.
